items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: I traded a fellow by the name of Mike Riley for that trombone in 27.

ctx.x: Company. Oh. Chicago. Harry B.J. Company, Chicago.
I traded a fellow by the name of Mike Riley for that trombone in 27. At the Elks Convention in Cleveland, Ohio.
That wouldn't be the Mike Riley that wrote Music Goes Round and Round. I don't know. What he did... The white fella?
